title: dimensions profiles
description: Editor aid for profiles.json: the setups that exist, by name. A profile is one combination of dimension values, or a list of them for a setup that can be in several, such as a tablet in either orientation. Profiles may share a combination. Once profiles exist, only their combinations do, and the dimensions they cover have no default. The dimensions compiler is the authority: it also checks that dimensions and values are declared, that every combination names the same dimensions, and that no profile lists a combination twice, which this schema cannot express.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editors.

profiles.description: Profile name -> dimension -> value, or a list of those.

name.description: Non-blank, without leading or trailing whitespace or control characters.

profile.description: One combination, or a list of them.

combination.description: One value for each dimension the profiles cover.
